::: {#exr-same-length}
#### Words of the same length

Let $K = \set{\text{if}, \text{let}, \text{cond}, \text{list}, \text{cons}, \text{define}}$, six words used in Racket,
and on $K$ let $a \sim b$ when the words $a$ and $b$ have the same number of letters.
Which words $a \in K$ have $a \sim \text{cond}$?

:::
